name: Austin Oil Price Forecasting Model
info: ARIMA-based time series forecasting model for oil price predictions. Generates forecasts for WTI crude oil prices with confidence intervals and market insights.

forecast_days.name: Forecast Period (Days)
forecast_days.tooltip: Number of days to forecast oil prices into the future. Shorter periods are generally more accurate.

start_date.name: Forecast Start Date
start_date.tooltip: The date from which to begin the forecast. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

confidence_level.name: Confidence Level
confidence_level.tooltip: Statistical confidence level for the forecast intervals. Higher values give wider prediction bands.

forecast.name: Price Forecast
forecast.unit: contains dates, prices, and confidence intervals

summary.name: Forecast Summary
summary.unit: statistical summary of the forecast period

model_info.name: Model Information
model_info.unit: metadata about the model and forecast
